thread:
Jess L (Support): prod eu-east1 hosted inference is getting slammed with 502s and timeouts since ~09:12 UTC. multiple customers escalating (auth failures, timeouts, billing noise). starting to get angry threads. @Arnold please take oncall.
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Incident INC-2026-324 created (P1) by Jess L (Support)
Anna K (SRE): on it. gateway logs show a large increase in 502/504 from api-gateway-eu-east1, upstream resets and TLS handshake timeouts. grabbing more traces.
Samir D (Platform): graphing now — 5xx rate spiked at 09:11:20 -> ~24% of traffic, 99p latency went from 0.8s to 4.2s. retry storms seen from several customers but errors are upstream not 4xx.
Liz N (NetEng): I see packet loss between eu-east1-az-b and az-c around 09:10-09:16. BGP session flaps with transit provider 203.0.113.78. starting pcap on spine.
Arnold (oncall): acknowledged. will coordinate mitigations. first priority: stop user-impact asap, then mitigate root.
Jess L (Support): sample customer repro (from support):
```
$ curl -i -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}'
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway\nDate: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 09:13:05 GMT\nContent-Type: application/json\n{ "error": "upstream connection reset" }
```
Jess L (Support): customers also see intermittent 401s when gateway fails to reach auth service. probably cascading from timeout/retries.
Liz N (NetEng): traceroute from a failing gateway pod to model-host shows: 
```
traceroute to model-host (10.4.2.7), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1  10.4.1.1  0.4 ms  0.3 ms  0.3 ms
 2  172.16.0.5  0.6 ms  0.6 ms  0.6 ms
 3  * * *
 4  198.51.100.22  12.7 ms  13.1 ms  12.9 ms
```
Liz N (NetEng): tcpdump from spine shows retransmits and dup acks at 09:11:15-09:14:40. BGP updates: multiple withdrawals then re-adverts. pushing to provider NOC now.
Anna K (SRE): gateway logs (excerpt):
```
[09:12:58] upstream connection error: ECONNRESET -> upstream: model-host-10.4.2.7:443
[09:13:01] request timed out after 5000ms -> trace id=abc1234
[09:13:05] auth-service timeout -> returning 502 to client
```
Samir D (Platform): temporary mitigations in progress: enabling smart-routing fallback to eu-west1 for new requests, increase KV cache TTL to reduce calls to model-hosts, and bump gateway connection timeout to 10s to avoid cascading 401s.
Arnold (oncall): executed region-failover policy for low-priority customers, can we push critical customers to dedicated-route?
Anna K (SRE): yes, can route specific customer tokens to dedicated eu-west endpoints. doing whitelist now.
billing-bot: Noted potential billing noise due to retries. Created ticket BILL-549 and applied temporary invoice hold for impacted accounts flagged by support.
Jess L (Support): pushed notices to top 5 escalated customers with repro steps and ETA. asking them to avoid retry loops client-side for 30m.
Liz N (NetEng): provider NOC responded — they're seeing short-lived microbursts on peering causing asymmetric loss. they recommend moving critical traffic off that peer, opening transit case.
Samir D (Platform): rolling a routing config: prefer alternative transit peer and shift control-plane traffic away from affected spine. will monitor error rate.
Anna K (SRE): error rate dropping to ~8% after reroute and cache changes. latency tail still elevated but improving.
Arnold (oncall): good. next: schedule a cross-team postmortem, capture traceroutes/pcaps, and get SLA impact numbers for customers.
Jess L (Support): action items for immediate post-incident: 1) NetEng to confirm provider root cause and get SLA credit estimate; 2) Platform to add guardrail to reduce retry amplification; 3) SRE to add automated failover test in canary which simulates cross-AZ packet loss; 4) Support/Product to prepare customer communication.
Liz N (NetEng): filing RCA request to transit provider and attaching pcap + BGP update logs.
Anna K (SRE): saving logs/traces -> trace ids list saved to incident INC-2026-324. will attach to postmortem doc.
Jess L (Support): thanks all. please ping here when provider confirms. sending follow-up to impacted customers now. :thumbsup:
